name: False Prophet
text: When False Prophet dies, exile all creatures.
flavor: "You lived for Serra's love. Will you not die for it?"
rulings: [{'date': '2004-10-04', 'text': 'False Prophet only exiles creatures, which means only creature permanents which are on the battlefield. It won’t exile itself since it is already in the graveyard.'}]
original_text: When False Prophet is put into a graveyard from play, remove all creatures from the game.
